posts.cooked:
@sayan @Subendu

I solved only one question in the oppe of System Commands, still my score is displayed as 43, which makes me just pass and removes the chance of appearing for re-oppe. In instructor/ TA sessions we were told only latest “synchro eval” will be considered for evaluation. so that way only one of my question should have got the score.

Kindly help and correct this, due to back to back OPPE on next day, I did want to appear in re-oppe with better preparation and therefore solved only 1 question and just tried the other. But this 43 score for one correct question snatches away the chance of re-oppe from me. I have really done well in quiz 1 and overall CGPA is also standing good at this stage of my BS Programme.

Kindly request you to update/correct the score please, this is a sincere request so that I can appear in the re-oppe in 2nd slot of 23-24 Aug.

Regards,

Sandeep

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
22f3002925:

In instructor/ TA sessions we were told only latest “synchro eval” will be considered for evaluation

That is incorrect, your highest marks are considered.

If you have solved two questions, you have passed the OPPE.

If you have passed the OPPE, you cannot attempt re-OPPE, these are by following the grading pattern.

Please note that a re-oppe is only available for students who did not pass the exam. Since you have successfully passed, our policy does not allow us to grant you a re-oppe.

posts.name: sandeepkumar sudhakar surkute
posts.cooked:
ok but this input that maximum of all attempts will be finally considered for evaluation is contrary to what I was informed in the live session. In live session I was informed that the latest “synchro eval” will be considered as is the case for any submission in the graded assignment questions.

At the end, I lost the re-oppe chance due to mis-information in the live session and CGPA would also be affected that was built >9.5 with lot of hard work that too in one of my favourite subject of System Commands.
